query:
insert into ticket_voids (id, event_id, numbers, reason, note, created_by)
           select $1, $2, int4range($3, $3, '[]'), 'revoked', $4, $5
           where not exists (select 1 from ticket_voids where event_id = $2 and undone_at is null
                             and numbers @> $3::int4)
           returning id
